summary: This bill reauthorizes the COPS ON THE BEAT grant program, allocating $1,047,119,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031, and formally establishes the Office of Community Oriented Policing Services (COPS Office) as a separate entity within the Department of Justice.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes and clarifies the authority of the COPS ON THE BEAT grant program, which funds community-oriented policing services. By providing continued funding and establishing the COPS Office as a separate entity within the Department of Justice, the bill directly supports stronger policing and law enforcement efforts.
